headline: TECK-BACKED VALHALLA FIRES UP FIRST DRILL AT AMBLER DISTRICT'S SUN VMS — TARGETS EXTENSION OF 6.84% CuEq BEST HOLE (TSXV:VMXX)
source_name: Investing News Network / Valhalla Metals Inc.
snippet: Valhalla Metals Inc. (TSXV: VMXX) commenced its 2026 drill program July 13 at the Sun volcanogenic massive sulphide (VMS) project in Alaska's Ambler Mining District — with Teck Resources holding a 31.4% strategic stake, the program targets down-dip and along-strike extensions of the Main Sun and SW Sun copper-zinc-silver-lead-gold deposits beyond the current resource model. The 2023 campaign returned a best intercept of 21.4 metres at 6.84% copper equivalent within a broader 52.4-metre interval at 3.30% CuEq, making the Ambler District — home to several of North America's largest undeveloped critical mineral deposits — one of the most compelling expansion targets at a time when Western governments are funding non-China copper and zinc supply chains.

headline: PREMIER URANIUM COMPLETES NEW MEXICO CEBOLLETA DRILL — SAMPLES TO HAZEN RESEARCH AS US PROJECT HITS METALLURGICAL PHASE (TSXV:PUR)
snippet: Premier American Uranium Inc. (TSXV: PUR) announced July 13 the successful completion of its 2026 drilling program at the wholly owned Cebolleta Uranium Project in New Mexico, with recovered underground resource samples now delivered to Hazen Research Inc. for advanced metallurgical testing to support process optimization and project economics studies. Cebolleta sits in a pro-mining New Mexico jurisdiction and ranks among the most advanced undeveloped US uranium assets in development — its advancement to metallurgical testing is a material milestone in Premier's strategy to bring a domestic uranium supply project into production within the same timeline as US and Canadian nuclear energy expansion plans.

headline: STERLING HITS 323M AT 0.34% CuEq CONTINUOUS FROM SURFACE AT SOO COPPER — DRILL 30 OF 2026 PROGRAM EXPANDS ONTARIO SYSTEM (TSXV:SAG)
source_name: Investing News Network / Sterling Metals Corp.
snippet: Sterling Metals Corp. (TSXV: SAG) released July 13 assay results from three additional holes — SC-26-07, SC-26-08, SC-26-09 — at the Soo Copper Project near Batchewana Bay, Ontario, each intersecting 248 to 323 metres of continuous copper mineralization beginning from near surface grading 0.30% to 0.34% CuEq. Sterling is now on its 30th hole of the 2026 program with 15,000 metres completed of a minimum 20,000-metre campaign and has drilled more than 25,000 metres at Soo since spring 2025, with strong correlation between copper mineralization and IP chargeability anomalies continuing to validate a large, copper-dominant system with significant expansion potential.

headline: ALL 5 HOLES HIT VMS SULPHIDES AT CASCADE'S MAIDEN CENTREFIRE DRILL — WABIGOON BELT, SURFACE RUNS 2.86% CU, 2.84 g/t AU (CSE:CASC)
snippet: Cascade Copper Corp. (CSE: CASC) announced July 13 the completion of its maiden five-hole diamond drill program at the Centrefire Copper-Gold Project, 40 kilometres from Dryden in the Wabigoon Greenstone Belt of Northwestern Ontario — every hole intersected sulphide mineralization indicative of a volcanogenic massive sulphide (VMS) environment, confirming the geological model ahead of assay results. Surface sampling at Centrefire has returned values up to 2.86% Cu, 2.84 g/t Au, and 23.5 g/t Ag; pending assays, the company is considering a borehole electromagnetic survey to test for blind VMS conductors and a Phase 2 program targeting along-strike and depth extensions.

headline: SECOND RC RIG DRILLING AT MADISON COPPER-GOLD — NEAR-SURFACE SKARN AND DEEP PORPHYRY BOTH TARGETED IN FUNDED 15,000M MONTANA PROGRAM (CSE:USGD)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / American Pacific Mining Corp.
snippet: American Pacific Mining Corp. (CSE: USGD) announced July 13 that a second reverse circulation drill rig has arrived and commenced drilling near-surface skarn targets at the Madison Copper-Gold Project in Montana as part of a fully funded 15,000-metre program — approximately 10,000 metres will test near-surface skarn mineralisation while 5,000 metres targets the deeper porphyry-style copper-gold system identified by a 2026 magnetotelluric survey, making Madison one of the few junior copper-gold projects in the western United States running both skarn and porphyry targets concurrently in a single funded campaign.

headline: ED STEER: GOLD AND SILVER 'READY TO SURGE' — EASTERN DEMAND, SILVER SHORTAGE, AND LATE WESTERN CAPITAL LOADING THE SPRING
snippet: Veteran precious metals analyst Ed Steer tells Money Metals Exchange that while gold and silver spent much of 2026 consolidating after January's sharp correction from record highs, the fundamental setup for the next major move higher has strengthened during the pullback — pointing to rising Eastern demand (PBOC adding 14.93 tonnes in June alone, extending a 20-month buying streak), structural silver supply deficits now in their sixth consecutive year, and early signs of Western institutional capital beginning to re-engage a market it largely abandoned after January. Steer argues that compressed Western investment positioning combined with sustained Eastern accumulation creates the coiled-spring dynamic that has historically preceded the most explosive legs of the gold-silver bull market.

headline: TECHNICAL SCOOP: GOLD BREAKS 4-WEEK LOSING STREAK, TSX GOLD INDEX +4.1% — MARGIN DEBT AT RECORD $1.2T ADDS SYSTEMIC RISK
snippet: David Chapman's July 13 Technical Scoop documents the week's key signals: gold broke a four-week losing streak with the Gold Bugs Index gaining 2.1% and the TSX Gold Index climbing 4.1%, consistent with the historical mid-July seasonal inflection that has preceded the strongest autumn gold rallies of the current bull market. Chapman flags a structural systemic risk building in the background: US margin debt has jumped 53.7% over the past year to a record $1.2 trillion — a leverage indicator that historically peaks within 3-12 months of major market tops — while Canada's July 10 employment report, WTI oil near pre-conflict levels at $68-69, and the approaching June CPI print form the macro backdrop heading into one of the most consequential weeks for precious metals investors in Q3 2026.
